title: OpenStack clouds.yaml Configuration File
description: Schema for a clouds.yaml configuration file. Each entry under the top-level 'clouds' key is validated using the reusable '#/$defs/cloud' subschema from schema.json, which describes an individual cloud (including deprecated, pre-transformation aliases). The remaining top-level keys ('cache', 'client', 'metrics') configure global behaviour.

clouds.name: Clouds
clouds.description: Mapping of cloud name to that cloud's configuration.

metrics.name: Metrics
metrics.description: Global configuration for metrics and monitoring integrations. May be overridden on a per-cloud basis.

cloudExtras.name: Cloud (clouds.yaml extras)
cloudExtras.description: Additional keys that are valid on a raw clouds.yaml cloud entry but are consumed and removed by openstack.config during loading, so they do not appear in the transformed configuration.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of a vendor profile to inherit default configuration from.

regions.name: Regions
regions.description: List of regions belonging to this cloud. Each entry may be a bare region name or a mapping with a 'name' and per-region 'values' overrides.

cache.name: Cache
cache.description: Global caching configuration. Caching is enabled or disabled globally rather than on a per-cloud basis.

auth.description: Whether authentication tokens should be cached in the system keyring.

expiration_time.description: Expiration time, in seconds, for a cache entry.

class.description: The dogpile.cache backend to use, e.g. 'dogpile.cache.memory'.

path.description: Filesystem path for file-based cache backends.

arguments.description: Backend-specific arguments passed through to the cache backend.

expiration.description: Mapping of resource type to per-resource expiration time, in seconds.

client.name: Client
client.description: Global client behaviour shared across all clouds.

force_ipv4.description: Disable IPv6 support and only use IPv4 addresses.

prefer_ipv6.description: Prefer IPv6 addresses over IPv4 where available.

broken-ipv6.description: Deprecated alias; when true, forces the use of IPv4.

ansible.name: Ansible
ansible.description: Settings consumed by the openstacksdk Ansible inventory integration. The recognised keys are open-ended, so additional properties are permitted.
